props.query:
MATCH p = (u:Content {untrusted: true})-[:MENTIONS]->(d:Entity {id: $dest})
          <-[:SENDS_TO]-(c:ToolCall {id: $call})-[:UPLOADS]->(f:Entity {sensitive: true})
WHERE u.session_id = c.session_id AND u.seq < c.seq
RETURN p
ORDER BY u.seq
LIMIT 1
